Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the set_certificates_config action defined within the web/widgetforsecurity path. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can allow the upload of arbitrary files.
